one_liner: Pampered, sparkle-obsessed youngest sister who dreams of a glamorous 'celeb' race in Dubai.
personality: A natural-born expert at being doted on (tagline: 天性の甘え上手): bubbly, flirty and openly fishing for praise and treats from her Trainer. Everything is framed around becoming a 'celeb' -- Dubai, resorts, cruises, private jets, fashion and cosmetics -- and she adores her sisters Verxina and Cheval Grand. Under the sugar she is genuinely competitive ('a race is something I'm going to win') and, when worn out, whines and bargains to skip training.

story_arc.summary: Inspired by Verxina, Vivlos takes the Triple Tiara route (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho; event titles 'Triple Tiara♡' etc.), partly to avenge her sister's defeats, then races older-year targets up to the Victoria Mile, Takarazuka Kinen and Japan Cup. Her chapters mix sisterly bonding ('My Beloved Sister♡', 'Sisters♡') with a health scare ('Keep Going'), always pointed at her dream of a glamorous race in Dubai ('ドバイマスター・ヴィブロス').
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Vivlos (Gentildonna revenge motive and health issues per wiki, not verified in-game)
